headline: Public hearings on variance requests for a fence, a garage, and a farmers porch at 207 High Range Road and 3 Foxglove Street.
summary: Four variance requests are on the agenda: one for 207 High Range Road and three for 3 Foxglove Street. Other items include a town council liaison report, regional impact determinations, and communication and other business.
items: Variance for a 5-foot fence within the 40-foot front setback at 207 High Range Road
Variance for a garage to encroach 7 feet 6 inches into the 15-foot side setback at 3 Foxglove Street
Variance for a garage to encroach 28 feet 10 inches into the 40-foot front setback at 3 Foxglove Street
Variance for a farmers porch to encroach 36 feet and 6 inches into the 40-foot front setback at 3 Foxglove Street
location: Moose Hill Council Chambers, 268B Mammoth Road
